body.label: Target
body.html: Self or one willing ally within 4 units.

body.label: Effect
body.html: Trigger: An attack targets the creature from a source you detect, before rolling. Response (unopposed): Grant +1 to the targeted Defense against that attack and reveal the source's occupied space to the target.

surges.html: The target may move 1 unit toward you.
Suppress one ordinary sensory penalty on the target until the start of your next turn.
